📖 How to use

  1. Click the box to start a round.
  2. Wait for it to turn green — don't click early.
  3. Click as fast as you can when it turns green.
  4. After 5 valid rounds you get your average and rating.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many rounds count?

Five valid rounds. Clicks before the green light are fouls — the round is void and you retry it.

What is a good score?

Under 200ms is excellent, under 250ms great, under 300ms good, under 400ms average. Most people land around 250ms.

Is my best average saved?

Yes, in your browser's local storage. Nothing is sent anywhere.
